Loss report: gitlab -> argo

[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.api (the source runs on the events api, trigger and its file has no trigger form for them; Argo has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline and its file has no trigger form for them; Argo has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat and its file has no trigger form for them; Argo has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.schedule (the source runs on the events schedule and its file has no trigger form for them; Argo has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (rules) is not written to the Argo file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy job.if (the condition is gitlab text, which Argo cannot read; the task is disabled with when {{= false }})
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/source-checkout step.action: input git artifact at /workspace (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha workflow parameters carry the repository and the commit; a private repository needs credentials on the git artifact, which the file does not set; a private repository needs usernameSecret and passwordSecret, or sshPrivateKeySecret, on the git artifact; the file names none)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy/step/source-checkout step.action: input git artifact at /workspace (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha workflow parameters carry the repository and the commit; a private repository needs credentials on the git artifact, which the file does not set; a private repository needs usernameSecret and passwordSecret, or sshPrivateKeySecret, on the git artifact; the file names none)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.manual: empty context parameters; argo submit --from workflowtemplate/gitlab-ci (a manual run starts the template with no value for ctx-repo, ctx-sha; a checkout then clones https://github.com/.git. Pass the values with argo submit -p, or set them under spec.workflowSpec.arguments; start a run with: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/gitlab-ci; the Workflow object needs a ServiceAccount with the rights in .argo/rbac/)
